title: callista longipes
intro: Callista longipes, commonly known as the "Fragrant Orchid", is a plant species belonging to the Orchidaceae family. This plant is prized for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Callista longipes include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as decongestant and expectorant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
